lines.text: I think I found a broken Legendary.
The Star Leviathan. A space whale that sings shockwaves. It costs three hundred and fifty.
Against three basic soldiers, it barely survives.
Add just one more... and it falls. Four soldiers. Two hundred gold.
Every other Legendary I tested beats six to thirteen of them. So is this a bug? Or is it meant to stand behind a front line?
Buff it, or leave it? You tell me.
